answer_1.quote: In this work, we develop POSTMARK, a watermarking approach with relatively high detection rates even in the presence of paraphrasing attacks. POSTMARK is a post-hoc watermark that given some model-generated text, finds words conditioned on the semantics of the text using an embedding model, then calls a separate instructionfollowing LLM to insert these words into the text without appreciably modifying its meaning.
